newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - March 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - March 21.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on March 21. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Planning Minister Ginanjar Kartasasminta said Indonesia recorded 7.82 percent growth in 1996. He said the growth rate was satisfiying although it was slower than the revised growth figure of 8.21 percent in 1995.

Indonesia's Central Bureau of Statistics said the burden on the country's external balance of payments had prompted the government to irrationally pursue exports at all costs in order to raise badly needed foreign exchange.
Rescue workers in East Kalimantan are still searching for the body of Bre-X geologist Mike de Guzman who fell out of a helicopter on Wednesday on his way to the giant Busang gold find.
Indonesia's state-owned telecommunication company PT Telkom posted a net profit of 1.5 trillion rupiah in 1996 against 906.9 rupiah in 1995.
Four people were injured after a Garuda Indonesia Boeing 747 jet skidded off the runway when it landed at Taipei international airport early on Thursday.
